section_summary: This section contains Department of State correspondence, military permit notifications, applications, and memoranda concerning entry and travel regulations for Japan and Korea between August and October 1948. It documents clearances, re-entry arrangements, and exit permit waivers for foreign commercial representatives, missionaries, and private individuals handled in cooperation with the Department of the Army and SCAP. Additionally, the records address broader travel policies, including Far Eastern Commission discussions on Japanese nationals traveling abroad, organized tourist travel by the Japan Travel Bureau, and good offices extended for repatriation to Cuba and Austria.
